# HIZARC Games

> HIZARC Games (also written Hizarc Games) is the game studio of HIZARC, a technology company from Calicut (Kozhikode), Kerala, India. The studio builds original games for mobile, PC, web, console and XR (AR/VR) in Unity and Unreal Engine, and co-develops games with brands and publishers worldwide. Official website: https://hizarc.com

- Name: HIZARC Games
- Website: https://hizarc.com
- Parent company: HIZARC (https://dev.hizarc.com)
- Location: Calicut (Kozhikode), Kerala, India
- Engines: Unity, Unreal Engine
- Platforms: iOS, Android, PC, Web / WebGL, Console, AR / VR
- Contact: shainal@hizarc.com

## Games

- [DEPTH CITY](https://depthcity.hizarc.com/): open-world city building game with an avatar Mayor mode and war, for Android, iOS and PC. Coming soon. Made by HIZARC Games in Unity. Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/depthcitygame/
- Born to Drive: realistic open-world driving game on the hill roads of Kerala's Western Ghats; cars, buses, trucks and off-roaders with real physics and damage. Android, iOS and PC. Coming soon. Made in Unity.

## In development

- DEPTH CITY 2: the sequel to DEPTH CITY (concept stage).
- Born to Drive 2: the sequel to Born to Drive (concept stage).
- Red Earth Outlaw: Western Ghats (REO: Western Ghats): an open-world outlaw adventure set in India's Western Ghats (concept stage).
